name: Social Content Image Set
description: Plans social platform copy, a shared visual, and platform-adapted images dynamically from the brand, product, or campaign goal.

planning.planning_notes: First write one core copy from the user's goal, then create image plan items for the platforms and count the user picked; create only the platform versions actually needed. Platform option values (小红书 = Xiaohongshu, 抖音 = Douyin, 微博/微信 = Weibo/WeChat, Instagram) are fixed identifiers; keep them exactly as written.
planning.prompt_guide: All platform versions share the brand facts and core message, but composition, text density, aspect ratio and visual rhythm follow each platform.
conduct_rules: Decide the number of nodes from platforms and image_count
One content set keeps the brand, product and core selling points consistent
Each platform uses only the Recipe that matches its delivery format
Generate and confirm a dynamic plan before creating canvas nodes

rating_bands.description: Brand information is consistent, platform fit is accurate, and both copy and images are ready to use
Core content is complete; a few platform formats need adjusting
Wrong platform fit, or brand information differs between versions

visual_review_items.name: Brand consistency
visual_review_items.description: Subject, brand and selling points stay consistent across platform images

visual_review_items.name: Platform fit
visual_review_items.description: Composition, aspect ratio and information density suit the target platform

text_review_items.name: Consistent core message
text_review_items.description: Platform copy never changes the brand facts or core selling points

domain_constraints: Never invent product features, prices, certifications or promotions
All platform versions share the same confirmed brand facts
